description: Planted binary drift: intercept shift of +0.75 (logit) from period 3 onward.
sizingNote: 4,000 entities x 6 periods = 24,000 rows (Ruling Q9: >= 3,000 x 6), shift in the later 3 periods (12,000 rows each side). The logit shift 0.75 has SE about 0.03, so it is > 20 SE; the positive rate moves by about 15 points, far beyond period-to-period sampling noise (SE ~0.008 per period).
